Brown Cardigan & Plaid Skirt Parlor
Rights check
Source: 24396.jpg
Cozy, classic, vintage-inspired
WORKING NOTES
- The cream collar and plaid skirt are the signature details.
- Add 'full-length' to show the tassel hem.
Try this: Use full-length framing to show the tassel hem.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
straight black hair and a cream knit beret
stands in an elegant parlor with cream
walls and a fireplace. She wears a
brown knit cardigan with a cream
peter-pan collar, gold buttons, and a
small brooch, paired with a long brown
and cream plaid skirt with a tassel hem.
She holds a cream structured bag with
tan leather handles. A straw boater hat
and magazine rest on a nearby
armchair. Warm, soft interior light.
Palette of chocolate brown, cream, and
warm gold. Cozy and classic, in the style
of a vintage-inspired fashion editorial.
